connector.name: Engram by NickCirv
connector.registryDescription: Ranked local code-graph context for AI coding agents. Intercepts reads + greps. Apache-2.0.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package engramx. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nickcirv account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ENGRAM_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional HTTP bearer token. Auto-generated at ~/.engram/http-server.token if unset.

env.name: ENGRAM_MISTAKE_GUARD
env.description: Pre-mortem warnings: '1' = warn, '2' = deny. Unset = off, zero overhead.

env.name: ENGRAM_ANTHROPIC_MEMORY_PATH
env.description: Override path to Claude Code's Auto-Memory MEMORY.md.

env.name: ENGRAM_MCP_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Override path to ~/.engram/mcp-providers.json (plugin MCP server declarations).

env.name: ENGRAM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK
env.description: Set to '1' to disable passive update notice. Auto-disabled when $CI is set.
